About

About Femylabs

Femylabs LLC is a technology company specializing in privacy-preserving security infrastructure for regulated industries. The company builds software systems that enforce compliance requirements at the architecture level — through cryptographic and systems engineering decisions applied before production deployment, not through policy overlays added after the fact.

Femylabs addresses a specific class of problem: regulated organizations that must demonstrate compliance with federal and state mandates — Electronic Visit Verification under the 21st Century Cures Act, HIPAA Security Rule requirements, FTC geolocation data enforcement — while operating cloud infrastructure and mobile applications at scale.

The company's work spans healthcare compliance, cloud infrastructure security, and gig economy location privacy. Industries served include Medicaid-funded home care, small and mid-sized AWS environments, and organizations requiring privacy-minimizing location verification without raw GPS transmission.

Research & Intellectual Property

Research & Intellectual Property

Patent — Filed

Zero-Knowledge Route Promise (ZKRP)

ZKRP is a privacy-minimizing cryptographic commitment scheme that allows a mobile device to prove physical presence at a location without transmitting or storing raw GPS coordinates. The protocol is deployed in production in Veraphos for Electronic Visit Verification compliance.

USPTO Provisional Patent Application No. 64/086,733  ·  Filed June 9, 2026
